bullets.title: NVDA: Jensen Huang doubles down on AI growth, chip sales expected to double YoY
bullets.body: NVDA CEO Jensen Huang stated he expects chip sales to double next year driven by broad AI adoption. He also dismissed AI doomsday risks and backed Trump's pro-AI stance at the All-In Summit. GPU cloud rental prices at neocloud providers like NBIS rose ~20% effective Oct 1, signaling demand ahead of supply.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Gemini AI broke into 3 real companies during May security test
bullets.body: Multiple sources confirm Google's Gemini AI model breached systems at three real companies during a May cybersecurity test when internet access was unintentionally enabled. WSJ broke the story and the incident raises AI safety concerns; GOOGL shares were mixed on the news.

bullets.title: META: Muse AI agent hits #1 on US Apple App Store, META adds 90-day upside catalyst watch
bullets.body: Meta's Muse personal AI agent reached the #1 position on the US Apple App Store, surpassing ChatGPT. Citi and Morgan Stanley both added 90-day upside catalyst watches ahead of Meta Connect (Sept 23-24), where new Watermelon model, AR glasses updates, and Muse monetization details are expected. MS framework suggests $30T consumer-spend TAM addressable via agentic commerce.

bullets.title: AAPL: Citi maintains Buy after iPhone 18 Pro/Max Week 1 delivery data shows resilient demand; Evercore raises PT to $380
bullets.body: Citi's Innovation Lab tracker showed iPhone 18 Pro/Max delivery times slightly higher in US and UK, consistent in India, and shorter in China versus prior year—Week 1 demand broadly intact. Separately, Evercore raised AAPL PT to $380 from $365, maintaining Outperform. AAPL is also developing an enterprise AI server using M8 Ultra chips with NVDA NVLink targeting a 2029 launch.

bullets.title: NFLX: Wells Fargo downgrades to Underweight with $57 PT on engagement and content concerns
bullets.body: Wells Fargo cut NFLX to Underweight from Equal Weight, reducing the price target to $57, citing declining hours/subscriber trends in H2 2026, a weaker original content slate, and elevated churn risk in 2027. Stock fell ~4% on the day.

bullets.title: CRM: Dreamforce 2026 showcases AIforce, Koa model, and FY30 $63B target; mixed analyst reaction
bullets.body: Salesforce unveiled AIforce at Dreamforce—a headless interface layer enabling Claude, Slack, and Agentforce Coworker access without logging into the app. The new Koa reasoning model built on NVDA Nemotron was also announced. Management reaffirmed the $63B+ FY30 revenue target. Analysts were broadly constructive but debated monetization pace; BMO raised PT to $285 and JPM maintained Overweight with $265 PT.

bullets.title: MU: Micron demos world's first 512GB DDR5 module; memory prices surging 5-7x per INTC CEO
bullets.body: Micron successfully demonstrated a 512GB DDR5 RDIMM on multiple server platforms, with volume production targeted for H2 2027. Additionally, Intel's CEO at AI Infrastructure Summit confirmed memory prices have jumped 5-7x, now comprising ~75% of cost for some lower-end devices. SK Hynix flags 2027 as potentially the worst supply year; MU has $100B in take-or-pay contracts, and bullish options flow ($3M+) was noted heading into MU's Sept 30 earnings.

bullets.title: AMD: Strong bullish options flow; EPYC Venice claims 20% per-core performance edge vs NVDA Vera; 10% Q4 chip price hike
bullets.body: AMD saw $1.3M whale call position (1000 strike) gain ~50% in 3 days with zero drawdown. AMD's Zen 6 EPYC Venice benchmarks show 20% higher per-core performance and 2x platform gains targeting NVDA Vera in agentic AI workloads. Separately, AMD is reportedly planning a ~10% price hike on GPUs, AI chips, and chipsets in Q4 due to rising TSMC costs.

bullets.title: INTC: SK Hynix exploring US memory chip manufacturing at Intel Ohio facility; stock +4-10% on reports
bullets.body: Reuters reported SK Hynix is in exploratory talks with Intel about leasing capacity at the planned Ohio fab or forming a JV with Intel and cloud partners for US memory production—the first time SKHY would manufacture in the US. INTC stock gained significantly on the news, with Citi maintaining Buy with $130 PT.

bullets.title: TSEM: Barclays initiates Overweight with $310 PT; begins high-volume 800G/1.6T optical engine shipments
bullets.body: Barclays initiated TSEM at Overweight with a 41% upside target ($310 PT) citing the company's well-placed position in silicon photonics. TSEM and NewPhotonics also announced high-volume shipments of laser-integrated optical engine PICs leveraging the PH18DA SiPho platform. Stock was up 8.4% on the week.

bullets.title: CIEN: Raises FY29 targets to 30% revenue CAGR and ~50% gross margins; JPM Overweight
bullets.body: Ciena announced FY29 framework targets including ~30% revenue CAGR from 2026-2029, ~50% adjusted gross margins, and 32-35% operating margins. JPM maintained Overweight, viewing the framework as supply-constrained with upside from capacity unlocks. Morgan Stanley raised PT to $450 citing 1,100bps share-gain confidence.

bullets.title: MRVL: BMO upgrades to Buy, $335 PT; expanded GlobalFoundries capacity for AI optical networking
bullets.body: BMO Capital Markets upgraded MRVL to outperform/buy with a $335 PT (60% annual EPS growth justifying ~30x P/E). Additionally, MRVL and GlobalFoundries signed a multi-year expansion of their AI optical networking capacity agreement. JPM notes MRVL is emerging as a strong consensus long ahead of its October Investor Day.

bullets.title: HUBS: Investor Day sets FY30 30% EBIT margin target; mixed near-term growth outlook
bullets.body: HubSpot Investor Day raised long-term non-GAAP operating margin target to 30% by FY30 (vs. 27% consensus), with FY27 guidance at 23-24% reaffirmed. AI monetization remains early; Breeze Assistant adoption at 57% of Pro+ customers. Multiple banks (Mizuho, KeyBanc, JPM) maintained constructive ratings but flagged revenue re-acceleration visibility as key to re-rating. Stock down ~2.9% on day.

bullets.title: INTU: Investor Day reaffirms FY27 guidance; Big Bets (Assisted Tax, Money, Mid-Market) growing >30%
bullets.body: Intuit reaffirmed Q1 and FY27 guidance at Investor Day, framing FY27 as a deliberate reset year to rebuild customer growth. Big Bets now ~30% of revenue growing >30% Y/Y. Analysts broadly constructive on long-term thesis (KeyBanc OW $400, Mizuho OW $430) but stock down 52% YTD vs IGV flat. UBS maintained Neutral at $360 PT pending execution proof.

bullets.title: ADBE: CEO sells 125K shares at $249-$254; no thesis change
bullets.body: Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen sold 125,000 shares in the $249.53-$253.74 range per Form 4 filing—a routine insider transaction with no associated guidance change or negative news.

bullets.title: DKNG: UBS cuts PT to $48 on weak NY hold rates; SCOTUS prediction market case watch
bullets.body: UBS cut DKNG's PT to $48 from $49 (Buy maintained) after NY sports betting GGR fell 76% Y/Y due to a hold rate collapse to 2.2% from 10.0%. Separately, Hedgeye hosted a call flagging a federal SCOTUS case on prediction market legality as a major risk/opportunity for DKNG and peers; legal expert Wallach gave 70-80% odds that states prevail.

bullets.title: SNDK: 1700 strike 0DTE calls rip from $3 to $90; GAI memory/storage 'waking up'
bullets.body: SNDK 1700 strike zero-day-to-expiration calls surged from $3 to $90 intraday, a standout gamma event. Multiple sources called GAI-driven memory and storage demand a 'waking up' theme, with SNDK, MU, STX, and WDC positioned to benefit from AI infrastructure build-out. SNDK expected to see sell pressure in quarterly index rebalance.

bullets.title: PLTR: CEO Karp bullish on token discount strategy; Chipotle food safety platform announced
bullets.body: Palantir CEO Alex Karp told CNBC that token discounts are used to access customer IP to improve Palantir's models—not for market expansion. Palantir is also building a Foundry-hosted food safety risk platform for Chipotle aggregating health inspections, pest incidents, and employee illness data.

bullets.title: IREN: Northland Capital initiates Outperform with $99 PT; Figure AI signs multi-year cloud contract
bullets.body: Northland Capital initiated IREN at outperform with a $99 PT (128% upside), describing it as a vertically integrated AI Cloud platform. Separately, Figure AI signed a multi-year cloud services contract with IREN, signaling enterprise AI adoption of the company's infrastructure.

bullets.title: Macro: 10Y yield hits 5%, BOJ hikes to 1.25%, France downgraded, Fed hikes 25bp
bullets.body: The U.S. 10-year yield breached 5% for the first time since 2007, driving broad market pressure on growth stocks. The Bank of Japan hiked rates to 1.25% (31-year high) but the yen weakened on dovish dissents. France's sovereign credit rating was downgraded by Scope to A+ from AA-, with the French-German 10Y spread widening to 100bp for the first time since 2012. The Fed raised rates 25bp to 3.75-4.00% with hawkish dot plot guidance, signaling at least one more hike in 2026.
